title: Thanksgiving and Prayer, To Live Is Christ

questions.question: Paul and ____, servants of Christ Jesus, address the saints at Philippi, with the overseers and deacons.
questions.explanation: Philippians 1:1 (ESV): "Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and deacons:"

questions.question: Paul thanks his God in all his remembrance of them, making his prayer with joy, because of their ____ in the gospel from the first day until now.
questions.explanation: Philippians 1:5 (ESV): "because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now."

questions.question: And I am sure of this, that he who began a good work in you will ____.
options: bring it to completion at the day of Jesus Christ
never leave you nor forsake you
questions.correctAnswer: bring it to completion at the day of Jesus Christ
questions.explanation: Philippians 1:6 (ESV): "And I am sure of this, that he who began a good work in you will bring it to completion at the day of Jesus Christ."

questions.question: Paul holds them in his heart, because they are all partakers with him of ____, both in his imprisonment and in his defense of the gospel.
questions.explanation: Philippians 1:7 (ESV): "It is right for me to feel this way about you all, because I hold you in my heart, for you are all partakers with me of grace, both in my imprisonment and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel."

questions.question: Paul prays that their love may abound more and more, with knowledge and all ____.
questions.explanation: Philippians 1:9 (ESV): "And it is my prayer that your love may abound more and more, with knowledge and all discernment,"

questions.question: So that they may approve what is excellent, and so be pure and blameless for the day of ____.
questions.explanation: Philippians 1:10 (ESV): "so that you may approve what is excellent, and so be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,"

questions.question: Paul wants them to know that what has happened to him has really served to advance the ____.
questions.explanation: Philippians 1:12 (ESV): "I want you to know, brothers, that what has happened to me has really served to advance the gospel,"

questions.question: Because of Paul's imprisonment, so that it has become known throughout the whole imperial guard that his imprisonment is for ____.
questions.explanation: Philippians 1:13 (ESV): "so that it has become known throughout the whole imperial guard and to all the rest that my imprisonment is for Christ."

questions.question: Most of the brothers have become confident in the Lord by Paul's imprisonment, and are much more bold to speak the word without ____.
questions.explanation: Philippians 1:14 (ESV): "And most of the brothers, having become confident in the Lord by my imprisonment, are much more bold to speak the word without fear."

questions.question: Some preach Christ from envy and rivalry, but others from good will. Does Paul rejoice in those who preach from envy?
options: He does not care about them.
questions.explanation: Philippians 1:18 (ESV): "What then? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed, and in that I rejoice."

questions.question: Paul says, "For to me to live is ____, and to die is ____."
questions.explanation: Philippians 1:21 (ESV): "For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain."

questions.question: Paul is hard pressed between the two. His desire is to depart and be with ____, for that is far better.
questions.explanation: Philippians 1:23 (ESV): "I am hard pressed between the two. My desire is to depart and be with Christ, for that is far better."

questions.question: But to remain in the flesh is more necessary on ____ account.
questions.explanation: Philippians 1:24 (ESV): "But to remain in the flesh is more necessary on your account."

questions.question: Only let your manner of life be worthy of the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear that you are standing firm in one ____.
questions.explanation: Philippians 1:27 (ESV): "Only let your manner of life be worthy of the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of you that you are standing firm in one spirit, with one mind striving side by side for the faith of the gospel,"

questions.question: For it has been granted to you that for the sake of Christ you should not only believe in him but also ____ for his sake,
questions.explanation: Philippians 1:29 (ESV): "For it has been granted to you that for the sake of Christ you should not only believe in him but also suffer for his sake,"

key_verse_text: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
